name: Archives
description: ZIP archives as folders. Enter one and walk it, F5 out of it to unpack and into it to pack, F3 for a table of what is inside. Read from wherever the archive lives, including another plugin's file system; written where the machine can open it.
author: xcommander

settings.label: Compression
settings.note: Zero stores the files without compressing them, which is what you want for pictures and other archives. Nine is the smallest and the slowest.

settings.label: Names in older archives
settings.note: An archive made before UTF-8 does not say which code page its names are in. Nothing is guessed for names that do say.
